package.description: Local-first personal AI assistant — your data stays on your machine.

en-US.description: Local-first personal AI assistant — your data stays on your machine.
en-US.longDescription: A fully local, single-user AI assistant that runs on your own computer — no Docker needed on 64-bit Windows. Your knowledge base, notes, and credentials live in a local database encrypted at rest under a passphrase only you hold. Bring your own API keys, or run fully local models with Ollama.
en-US.name: SmartBrain
